question: Should OpenClaw adopt this broad removal of file-era runtime transcript behavior, including the Plugin SDK-adjacent session-identity transition, in one protected maintainer-reviewed change?
rationale: The branch changes durable session identity across core and plugin-facing paths; deciding whether the retained deprecated fields and migration boundaries are sufficient requires explicit maintainer ownership rather than automated triage.

options.title: Approve the SQLite-only direction after proof
options.body: Keep the refactor scoped to the documented SQLite runtime model, require redacted after-fix behavior evidence, and complete owner review of the plugin compatibility boundary.

options.title: Narrow the compatibility transition
options.body: Split or defer Plugin SDK-adjacent identity changes if maintainers want a separately reviewed compatibility and deprecation plan.

recommendation.title: Approve the SQLite-only direction after proof
recommendation.body: Keep the refactor scoped to the documented SQLite runtime model, require redacted after-fix behavior evidence, and complete owner review of the plugin compatibility boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied branch history shows sustained ownership of the proposed session-runtime design and its compatibility follow-ups.
